messages:
Leah (Finance): Heads-up: Product wants to run a 3-arm A/B pricing experiment for mid-market starting next month. Need decisions on grandfathering length, invoice metadata, and mid-cycle move handling. Looping in @Tom @Zoe.

Aria (Product): Plan: control = current list, variant A = +8% list with same thresholds, variant B = +15% with higher thresholds. Target 5% of mid-market accounts for 3 weeks. Want experiment_id on export rows. No PDF changes.

Tom (Billing Ops): We can surface experiment_id in the billing export easily. Invoice PDFs are harder; gateways vary. For mid-cycle plan moves we can either prorate days for seat fees + provisional bucket assignment, then recon after month close. I recommend provisional invoice + monthly recon with auto-credit for deltas < $30.

Jon (Sales): Sales requests 90-day grandfathering for customers on active discounts or committed deals; allow account teams to opt customers in earlier.

Zoe (Legal): 90 days is acceptable. Need short copy for customer notification and an opt-out flag. Suggested wording: "Customers on active commitments may retain current pricing for 90 days after experiment assignment; account teams can opt-in on request."

Leah (Finance): Decision checklist: 1) export experiment_id: yes 2) invoice PDF: no 3) grandfathering: 90 days opt-in allowed 4) mid-cycle: provisional + recon, threshold $30. Confirm?

Tom (Billing Ops): Confirmed. I'll add experiment_id column to billing_export (column name: experiment_id) and draft the runbook with recon steps and thresholds. Will also check Chargebee/Stripe behavior re: corrected invoices vs credit memos.

billing-bot: Scheduled job "pricing-ab-midmarket" for 2025-02-12T08:00:00Z (job id: pr-ab-2025-02-12).

Aria (Product): Acceptance criteria: net revenue delta within +/-2% for cohort, <1% increase in billing-related tickets, and export IDs present for attribution.

Jon (Sales): Sales will provide list of exempted accounts with negotiated pricing before rollout.

Leah (Finance): Great. Tom, post runbook + sample export in /docs and ping here when ready. Zoe, I'll send draft customer wording for legal review shortly.

Tom (Billing Ops): Will do, aiming EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
